ARBITRATION D0156 — record stands; claim rejected. A mint mark exists: the specimen's own mint_text records 'small mark by talons (soft on photo)', and the mark is visible as a small round device below the eagle's talons on C163_rev.webp. The Flora & Fauna series specification (numismatics.ph, 50 Sentimo page) gives the series mintmark as the Philippine Mint's Baybayin 'Pi'; the 1984 mintage (121,408,000) was struck at the Philippine Mint, and the collection glosses this mark 'BSP' (record mint_text: 'BSP / Philippine mint'). Gemini's claim of no mintmark rests on Numista pieces4084, which does not exist (404 — the type is N#2461 / KM#242), and a Drive file ID that is not real; its evidence is void.
